summary: VacantEntry::insert could replace a stale occupied slot, leaking its value through mem::forget and incorrectly incrementing num_elems. The fix drops the replaced slot and increments the count only when it was truly vacant. A verbatim reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at this commit: the fix adds no tests, secondary::tests::qc_secmap_equiv_hashmap uses direct insert rather than entry, and entry doctests do not replace stale occupied slots. Blocked pending a detecting upstream test; no tests were executed.
